title: shell-init puts the install path into sed's replacement and then unquoted into the eval'd dvb body, so an & renders a wrong path at rc 0 and a } $ or quote is interpreted as code
body:
FOUND 2026-10-16 by critic-shell on dc's ST0008 WP-03 build, and confirmed by vc at main 7842c4b1. The defect predates WP-03, and WP-03 does not fix it.

WHAT HAPPENS. `shell-init` renders the `dvb` body with the machine's install path filled in. lib/cmd/shell-init:242 and :245 put that path, `$(_shell_init_prefix)`, into the replacement of `sed "s|@@DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX@@|...|g"`. The body then carries it, unquoted, in `local prefix=${DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX:-<value>}` (:149), which every shell that evals the output interprets.
- An `&` in the path is sed's "the matched text": driven by vc with `/opt/a&b`, the line came out as `${P:-/opt/a@@DEVBIN_INSTALL_PREFIX@@b}`, at rc 0. critic-shell measured the same through shell-init.
- By reading the code, a `|` or `\` breaks the sed expression.
- A `}`, `$`, backtick or quote would be interpreted by the shell that evals the body: the path is code there, not data.

A path with these characters is rare, but the output is eval'd in every shell that runs `eval "$(bin/devbin shell-init zsh)"`, and it can fail silently (rc 0, a wrong path), which is the class No Silent Errors forbids.

WHAT A FIX MUST DO (vc's reading; the builder builds it and vc reviews it):
- Carry the path as data: escape it for sed's replacement (or fill it without sed), and single-quote it in the emitted body, with any `'` in it escaped, so no shell interprets it. Or refuse a path holding a character the render cannot carry, by name, before anything is emitted. Either way, never emit a wrong body at rc 0.
- One fill for every body (zsh, `--autoload`, and bash once ST0008 WP-03 lands), not one per caller.
- Arms: a path with `&`, `|`, `\`, a space, `$`, `}` and `'`, each evaluated in zsh and bash, and each either naming the path exactly or refused by name. Red first on main, green under BSD and GNU.

It ships in the next release, with everything open.

## Resolution

Fixed at 9daa07fe: the install prefix is filled as data, single-quoted in the body by the one render for zsh, --autoload and bash, and no sed sees it. Arms in shellinit.bats for & | \ space $ } ' under zsh and bash, and one through zsh autoload, red first on WP-03's tip (seven of eight; the space arm a guard), green under BSD and GNU; dc's targeted run 2026-10-17 05:03Z to 05:17Z went 428/429, its one red harness.bats's title rule on the dollar arm, fixed by retitling it with its body on its own line; landing suite 20261017-0636 (vc's landing suite at ca557b4d: 2384 of 2384 ok, 5 skips, .errors empty, 06:36:33Z to 06:45:14Z; seal kept in ~/Devel/scratch/devbin-vc/clone-archive/seals/20261017-0636/).
